title: Illustration pack manifest
description: External illustration pack for a single story version. Images are not embedded in Markdown. Anchor by paragraph index (0-based), never by page — pages drift with font and viewport.

storyVersion.description: Exact match against frontmatter version, or the content hash from computeStoryVersion(). Mismatch skips the whole pack.

src.description: Filename relative to the pack directory, or an absolute http(s) URL

paragraph.description: 0-based paragraph index in the story body (split on blank lines, same as the pager)

hash.description: Optional hash of the paragraph start from hashParagraphStart(). Mismatch skips only this image.
